Elmet Technologies, a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Elmet Group (

), said on Wednesday that the Defense Logistics Agency awarded it a contract worth about $36M to supply high-performance molybdenum and tungsten alloys and precision wire to the U.S. National Defense Stockpile.
These materials are used in the production of jet engine components and other demanding aerospace applications.

title: Elmet Technologies gets $36M defense logistics contract
